name: v0.5.2
body: - Wildcards are allowed in configurable exclusions.

name: v0.5.1
body: - Apple build of desktop app is now notarized and signed.

name: v0.5.0
body:
- Add builds for apple silicon.
- Desktop build is now an universal macos binary.

name: v0.4.0
body: - Now ships as a desktop gui app. - A new "nogui" binary is shipped alongside the gui version. - Fixes an issue where cosmetic filtering may not have worked anymore when faulty rules existed in filter lists.

name: v0.3.0
body:
- Make use of system resolver.
- Fix windows build (<https://github.com/Barre/privaxy/issues/23>).

name: v0.2.0
body:
- Inject styles and scripts before the `</body>` and `</html>` tags.
- Windows build
